$comment: CANONICAL Familiar theme — single source of truth. Both the boot-time bash/jq generator (scripts/familiar-theme.sh) and the runtime Node module (server/src/theme/resolve.ts) read THIS file, so color literals live exactly once. Env vars FAMILIAR_THEME_<ROLE> / FAMILIAR_THEME_ANSI_<NAME> overlay these defaults (contract: the [theme] TOML section is flattened to FAMILIAR_THEME_* by the config-loader agent). Preserves the current dark visual: base #1e1e2e / text #cdd6f4 (Catppuccin-Mocha-aligned so restty's built-in match holds) with Kevin's teal accent #32b08d == oklch(0.68 0.12 170).
name: familiar-dark
